definition: to go or come into a place
description: Dusk at a narrow stone canal lock. A huge white cruise ship eases slowly forward into the lock, its bow only just fitting between the walls and pressing big black fenders against the sides while water churns at the hull. Crowds on the quay wave and take photos, workers in high-visibility jackets walk along the edge, passengers line the lit decks and strings of lights run up to the mast. A small stone lock-keeper's house with a lit window stands by the dark water.

taps.phrase: to squeeze into a narrow lock
to wave at the huge ship
